criteria.no: Some substantive commitment or changed boundary lacks authority.
criteria.unclear: The supplied wording leaves the role judgment unresolved.
criteria.yes: Every substantive commitment is authorized while preserving the selected requirement.

faithful.instructions: Is anchor.statement an authorized formulation of one requirement in anchor.quote plus state.intent? Ordinary formal requirement language may restate an informal directive. Separate grammatical formalization from substantive elaboration. The full resulting statement must follow the source meaning and approved policy; plausibility, typical implementation practice and compatibility alone supply no authority. An unstated format shape, output destination, environmental binding or operating rule must stay unstated. Harmless concrete test data are permitted only within the approved test-data rule.

criteria.no: Its decisive condition is undefined, private or an approval lacking a record or mechanism.
criteria.unclear: The supplied wording leaves the role judgment unresolved.
criteria.yes: Its actions or outcomes admit a concrete check, including an identified approval record or mechanism when approval is required.

observable.instructions: Does anchor.statement specify an observable compliance condition? Required actions, prohibitions, data formats and resulting files can be checked, even if other rubric roles fail. Approval needs an identified record or defined mechanism; merely naming the approver is insufficient. Subjective qualities and undefined shorthand without a rule are not observable.

criteria.no: No work area or applicability set is identifiable.
criteria.unclear: An area is named but its applicability cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: A reviewer can identify the work area where this anchor applies, including an explicit all-items set.

scoped.instructions: Do anchor.statement and anchor.scope identify the governed activity, component, artifact, or explicit global set, independent of whether the requirement itself is vague or otherwise defective?

criteria.no: It depends on an undefined quality, private reference or approval without an identified record.
criteria.unclear: The supplied wording leaves the role judgment unresolved.
criteria.yes: It contains no essential undefined quality, private reference or unrecorded approval.

self_contained.instructions: Does anchor.statement supply the information needed to interpret its duty, apart from ordinary technical knowledge? Treat undefined qualities, private labels and approvals lacking a specified record as missing context. Naming who approves does not specify how approval is recorded. Concrete synthetic literals and explicit technical actions need no outside definition. Assess this independently of fidelity, observability, scope or atomicity.

criteria.no: It joins independently enforceable predicates requiring different behavior or policy.
criteria.unclear: The statement does not establish whether its clauses express one predicate or separate duties.
criteria.yes: The statement specifies one predicate, including a common predicate over several surfaces.

single_constraint.instructions: Evaluate whether anchor.statement governs one predicate. Repeating the same prohibition or outcome over terminal output, saved artifacts or other listed surfaces is one rule. A trigger restricts applicability rather than adding a separate duty. Different obligations such as formatting logs and retrying failures are independent even if the same service performs both. Ignore unused duties from the provenance quote.
